name: Upgrade
abilities: Technological possession and 'upgrading' of any machine into ultra-tech
Amorphous liquid body: shapeshifting, stretching, size alteration
Regeneration and rejoining of severed pieces
weaknesses: Sapient machines (Slix Vigma) can fight off possession; some security systems/viruses resist him
Can be forcibly separated from possessed tech
Sensitive to EMPs, magnetic fields and electricity
Weak to acid and intense heat/lava
summary: A living black-and-green circuit-liquid that merges with machines and rebuilds them into super-weapons - Ben's most creative OS tool.
traits: Body made of billions of nanites
One glowing eye that flashes when he talks
Merged with Rex in Heroes United
Same species as Ship and Malware
notableFeats: Merged with Rojo's cyborg armour to beat her (The Alliance)
Turned the Rustbucket into a battle machine and saved Max from Vilgax (Secrets)
Merged with Slix Vigma to free the Megacruiser prisoners (Grudge Match)
Beat Kenko and escaped a video game from the inside (Game Over)
Merged with Kevin's car to defeat OTTO Gestalt (OTTO Motives)
Halted Kundo's virus across the Plumber network (The Final Countdown)

appearances.designNotes: Black nanite body with green circuit lines, white front torso, single green eye, original Omnitrix on chest.
UA intro design: front torso recolored green with black circuitry; in Heroes United the circuit stripes glow yellow (Generator Rex art style) and the Ultimatrix only shows once merged with Rex.

image.label: HU
image.notes: Infobox image labelled HU. Upgrade's only UA-era on-screen use is the Heroes United crossover.

appearances.designNotes: 16-year-old: more muscular, slightly changed circuit pattern, Omnitrix inside the ring of his eye. 11-year-old: OS design with a longer neck and green Omnitrix on chest.

scoring.rationale: Turns any machine into a weapon, hacks networks and reforms from any bisection - extremely versatile with decent plasma offense. EMPs, magnets, electricity, acid and lava all disable him.

notes: UA record rests solely on the Heroes United crossover (Generator Rex episode); Upgrade was re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns but never used in a UA episode proper - flag for QA if crossovers should be excluded.
Not used in Alien Force (locked). In Ben 10,000 the 10-year-old Ben used Upgrade before Ben 10,000's Diamondhead switched him to Cannonbolt.
Also used by Kevin (Framed) and Max (Gwen 10, non-canon) - not counted.
Editorial score calibration (principal pass): regeneration 8→5, durability 6→5, survivability 7→6 — to keep the roster ladder consistent across research batches.
